While the integration of a plasmonic interaction within a standard Sagnac loop was a straight-forward solution it has demonstrated some significant drawbacks. Specifically it has shown a very high sensitivity to misalignments and required a very fine parameter tuning and a cumbersome system.
In addition, due to the setup limitations, it could only detect the nonreciprocity between plasmonic waves propagating forward or back along a predefined direction (i.e.,±k x directions).
